root_cause: The trial mails were short and generic: no end date, no price context, no statement of what happens to the data, and no concrete next step, unlike common SaaS trial mails.
prevention: A test now requires the end date with weekday, the yearly price, the payment methods, the 30-day data retention, a signed footer and no empty fields in every mail and variant.

evidence.runtime_status: unit-tested text only; no customer mail has been sent with the new text yet

limitations: Plain text only; no HTML layout
Which variant converts better is not known until 30 mails per variant have been sent
